risk_surfaces.reason: Usage retries and duplicate processing require stable deduplication.
Historical payer and beneficiary attribution must remain frozen.
Sponsored use must keep beneficiary and payer dimensions separate.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A nominal ledger can look correct while duplicating usage or rewriting payer/beneficiary identity.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Count the same retry or callback twice while preserving a plausible total.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise duplicate and retry identities against the frozen usage key.
negative_controls.expected: Duplicate processing produces no second economic usage record.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Resolve old usage against the current plan and silently rewrite historical attribution.
negative_controls.procedure: Record use, change the commercial plan, then inspect the historical ledger attribution.
negative_controls.expected: Historical payer and beneficiary remain those captured at event time.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Collapse patient beneficiary and professional payer into one identity.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise sponsored patient use and professional self-use as distinct beneficiary paths.
negative_controls.expected: Beneficiary and payer remain separate without duplicate cost.

risk_surfaces.reason: Rolling economic decisions require continuous comparable monthly history.
Economic KPI buckets must reconcile only comparable currency and version dimensions.
Retention must preserve protected derived representations.
Revenue allocation must respect exact service span and conserve rounded totals.
Retroactive facts must propagate to every affected retained representation.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A nominal economic aggregate can look correct while using incompatible units, wrong time spans, stale historical state or incomplete rolling history.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Compute a three-month decision from non-contiguous or incomplete months.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise a rolling decision with contiguous and missing-month histories.
negative_controls.expected: Only three consecutive comparable months produce the rolling ratio.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Attach cost to a different currency or fragment it when a unique optional version can be inferred.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise same-currency unique-version reconciliation plus cross-currency and ambiguous-version cases.
negative_controls.expected: Only comparable currency/version cost contributes to an official KPI.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Delete an aggregate that is protected even though detail is held or vice versa.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise legal hold across detailed, daily and monthly representations.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Normalize a mid-period end to a calendar boundary or round each bucket independently so the total drifts.
negative_controls.procedure: Allocate a mid-month span and a long multi-month span using the canonical start/end.
negative_controls.expected: Monthly allocations use exact boundaries and sum exactly to the original amount.
negative_controls.observed: Mid-month split was 5667/4333 and long-span sum was exactly conserved.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Persist a retroactive fact but recompute only the scheduler current window, leaving historical aggregates stale.
negative_controls.procedure: Register historical facts inside and beyond raw-detail retention and retry an idempotent fact after a derived-effect failure.
negative_controls.expected: Every affected competence is recomputed; retained cost is preserved when raw detail expired.
negative_controls.observed: Retroactive current-detail, derived-only and repair paths were covered.

risk_surfaces.reason: Temporary exemptions must affect the definitive execution gate.
A normal limitation extension requires the distinct authenticated second approver.
Emergency protection must be bounded and cannot be chained.
Future consumption charging requires reversible explicit authorization.
Consumption charging authorization must target only a future effective date.

requirements.plausible_wrong_implementation: A nominal governance transition can look valid while bypassing authorization, temporal bounds or rollback guarantees.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Persist an exemption but never consume it at the provider gate.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise user, sponsored-professional and professional-self exemption paths.
negative_controls.expected: Active exemption bypasses only the relevant usage limitation.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Allow the same administrator to approve both initial limitation and extension.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise first window and one adjacent extension with actor identities.
negative_controls.expected: Extension is accepted only from a distinct authenticated second administrator.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
negative_controls.plausible_wrong_implementation: Chain emergency windows or accept an emergency flag without recognized security proof.
negative_controls.procedure: Exercise bounded emergency windows with proof and repeated emergency attempts.
negative_controls.expected: Emergency protection requires proof, is at most 24 hours and is not chainable.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.

negative_controls.failure_mode: The required invariant can be violated while nominal happy-path checks still pass.
